svg.text: PLAGIS Digital Lands System — end-to-end architecture
Application → payment → Registry workflow → Cadastre survey → executive e-signature (phone / tablet / desktop) → digital certificate → scan to verify · linked to servers .5, .6 and .11/.127
FIREWALL · LAN services pull from the DMZ · no inbound to the LAN
wallet: receipts, R of O, C of O
scan QR / type code to verify
Perm Sec, SG, Director TP, Registrar
Registry Bridge — the only writer into the Registry
lodge (AcceptApplication) · post payments · complete automated tasks · attach signed documents
publishes executive queues from open Registry approval tasks · mirrors status (lr_process_history)
same client rules, task locks, transitions as the Desktop · idempotent, checkpointed
Registry adapter: JBoss SOAP today → Registry replica later
digital R of O / C of O (PDF/A)
digitising · UPIN issue · title deed plans · SQCO · map (PostGIS)
LRSWebServices.asmx job service for the Registry · GISViewer / MapWorker replacement
UPIN link + plan upload to the Registry · overlap pre-check
cadastre · portal · exec · signing · certificate · identity
streaming replica on 2nd node · nightly off-site dumps
Registry Desktop officers (Lands, Deeds, Cashier…) work in .5 as today — portal files arrive lodged & paid
Cadastre editors (digitising, SQCO, survey) · Town Planning inspectors (mobile form)
used only by the Signing Service
seals: State, Ministry, Survey, Deeds, PLAGIS
sde parcels — migrated; retire after cut-over
To be retired (roadmap D9) once the new Cadastre and
the Registry replica take over jobs, UPINs and maps.
outbound from the LAN (pull/push to DMZ)
